question: Why must the ultimate knower be accepted as free from time and limitation?
premises: No other knower can be posited without falling into infinite regress.
To remove that infinite regress, a final knower must be accepted.
That accepted knower must be free from time and limitation.
inference: Avoiding infinite regress requires accepting a knower who is not limited by time.
plain_english: No other knower can be admitted, because that would lead to infinite regress; to remove that regress, one must accept that knower as free from time and limitation.
